description: This file declares the interface for the WLD monitor module, including functions for initialization, destruction, updating status, sending notifications, debugging, stopping, and setting enable/interval parameters related to monitoring.

methods.name: wld_mon_initMon
methods.description: Initializes a monitor object with associated callback and user data.

methods.name: wld_mon_destroyMon
methods.description: Destroys a monitor object, releasing resources.

methods.name: wld_mon_writeActive
methods.description: Sets the active status of the monitor.

methods.name: wld_mon_sendUpdateNotification
methods.description: Sends an update notification for the monitor event.

methods.name: wld_mon_debug
methods.description: Outputs debugging information for the monitor.

methods.name: wld_mon_setEnable_pwf
methods.description: Sets whether the monitor is enabled.
